taxes._note: Taxes et droits payés par l'acheteur d'un logement au Mexique, par municipio (impôt d'acquisition) et par État (droit d'inscription au Registro Público). Chaque valeur vient d'un texte officiel LU le 15 oct. 2026, cité dans `source` ; détail, citations et cas de test dans ~/Payotte/mexique/rapports/phase-0/fiscalite-*.md et les sous-rapports de ~/Payotte/mexique/scratch/fiscal-*/. source.titre: INEGI, Comunicado de prensa 1/26, Unidad de Medida y Actualización (UMA) 2026, 8 January 2026

cancun.base: the highest of the price, the cadastral value (certificate under 180 days), an appraisal validated by the state and the seller's last declared value

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Benito Juárez, Quintana Roo, art. 26-27 (last reform POE 10 Dec. 2025)

notes: Due within 15 working days; the notary computes it and is jointly liable.

playa-del-carmen.base: the highest of the updated price, the cadastral appraisal (under 180 days), an appraisal validated by the state and the last declared value

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Playa del Carmen (formerly Solidaridad), Quintana Roo, art. 23 Quáter-Quinquies (reformed POE 10 Dec. 2025)

notes: The rate rose from 3% to 4% on 10 December 2025.

tulum.base: the highest of the updated price, the cadastral appraisal and a private or bank appraisal (each under 180 days)

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Tulum, Quintana Roo, art. 49-50 (last reform POE 10 Dec. 2025)

notes: The rate rose from 3% to 4% in December 2024.

cozumel.base: the highest of the updated price, the cadastral appraisal and a private or bank appraisal (each under 180 days)

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Cozumel, Quintana Roo, art. 27-28 (last reform POE 17 Dec. 2024)

isla-mujeres.base: the highest of the updated price, the cadastral appraisal, a private or bank appraisal and the last declared value

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Isla Mujeres, Quintana Roo, art. 24-25 (rate reformed POE 3 July 2025)

notes: A flat 4% since 3 July 2025, after a progressive table in force from December 2024.

bacalar.base: the highest of the price, the cadastral value and an expert appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Bacalar, Quintana Roo, art. 56-57 (last reform POE 9 Dec. 2024)

chetumal.base: the highest of the updated price, the cadastral appraisal and a private or bank appraisal (each under 6 months)

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Othón P. Blanco, Quintana Roo, art. 26-27 (last reform POE 11 Dec. 2025)

merida.base: the highest of the price, the cadastral value and an appraisal validated by the Yucatán cadastre

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Mérida, art. 58-60 (table reformed D.O. 28 Dec. 2022; last reform D.O. 30 Dec. 2024)

progreso.base: the highest of the price, the cadastral value and a validated appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Progreso, Yucatán, 2026, art. 22 (D.O. 31 Dec. 2025)

valladolid.base: the highest of the price, the cadastral value and a validated appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Valladolid, Yucatán, art. 60-62 (D.O. 31 Dec. 2025)

notes: Valladolid's table gives one rate per bracket with no fixed amount: Payotte applies the bracket's rate to the whole base, as written. A marginal reading would give a lower tax; ask the municipal treasury.

villahermosa.base: the highest of the price, an authorised appraisal and the cadastral value

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda Municipal del Estado de Tabasco, art. 110 and fifth transitional article (last reform P.O. 21 Aug. 2020)

san-cristobal-de-las-casas.base: the highest of the price, the property-tax base and an appraisal by the state cadastre or an authorised appraiser

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de San Cristóbal de las Casas, Chiapas, 2026, art. 8 (P.O. 081, 31 Dec. 2025)

oaxaca-de-juarez.base: the higher of the cadastral value and the declared value

source.titre: Decreto 1492, reform of the Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Oaxaca de Juárez 2026, art. 51 (P.O. 28 March 2026, in force 29 March 2026)

notes: Table in force since 29 March 2026; a higher table applied from 1 January to 28 March 2026.

huatulco.base: the highest of the declared value, the fiscal value and a valuation ordered by the municipal treasury

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Santa María Huatulco, Oaxaca, 2026, art. 73-78 (Decreto 1254, P.O. 28 Feb. 2026)

notes: Huatulco's law gives one rate per bracket with no fixed amount: Payotte applies the bracket's rate to the whole base, as written.
In force from the day after its publication on 28 February 2026.

puerto-escondido.base: the higher of the cadastral value and the declared value

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de San Pedro Mixtepec (Juquila), Oaxaca, 2026, art. 33-34 (Decreto 1238, P.O. 21 Feb. 2026)

veracruz.base: the higher of the transaction value and the cadastral value

source.titre: Código Hacendario para el Municipio de Veracruz, art. 133-136 (Decreto 719, G.O. 28 Dec. 2023)

notes: The code read is the version of 28 December 2023; the state's legal portal and gazette could not be reached to check later reforms.

tampico.base: the higher of the agreed price and the municipal cadastre's appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Tampico 2026, art. 13 and 70 (Decreto 66-937); Código Municipal para el Estado de Tamaulipas, art. 124-132

notes: A bill of 24 August 2026 proposes raising the state rate to 3%; it is not law.

guadalajara.base: for a home, the appraisal approved by the municipal cadastre; otherwise the higher of that appraisal and the price

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Guadalajara 2026, art. 28 (decree 30031/LXIV/25, published 25 Dec. 2025)

notes: For a home, Jalisco's law taxes the appraisal approved by the cadastre: enter it as the reference value.

zapopan.base: for a home, the appraisal approved by the municipal cadastre; otherwise the highest of the appraisal, the deed value and the cadastral value

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Zapopan 2026, art. 49 (decree 30111/LXIV/25, published 25 Dec. 2025)

notes: For a home, Jalisco's law taxes the appraisal approved by the cadastre: enter it as the reference value.

puerto-vallarta.base: the higher of an appraisal approved by the municipal cadastre and the agreed price

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Puerto Vallarta 2026, art. 41 (decree 30058/LXIV/25, published 25 Dec. 2025)

chapala.base: the higher of an appraisal approved by the municipal cadastre and the agreed price (state law, art. 114)

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Chapala 2026, art. 47 (decree 30011/LXIV/25, published 23 Dec. 2025)

notes: Chapala's law gives the table without the formula; Payotte applies the fixed amount plus the rate on the excess, as the column headings read.

bahia-de-banderas.nom: Bahía de Banderas (Nuevo Vallarta, Bucerías, Sayulita)
bahia-de-banderas.base: the highest of the price, a commercial appraisal and the cadastral appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Bahía de Banderas, Nayarit, 2026, art. 21 (P.O. 29 Dec. 2025)

tepic.base: the highest of the price, a certified bank or commercial appraisal and the cadastral value

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Tepic, Nayarit, 2026, art. 14 (P.O. 29 Dec. 2025)

manzanillo.base: the highest of the cadastral value, a commercial appraisal and the price

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda para el Municipio de Manzanillo, art. 25 and 28 (last reform Decreto 236, P.O. 31 Dec. 2025)

colima.base: the highest of the cadastral value, a commercial appraisal and the price

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda para el Municipio de Colima, art. 25 and 28 (last reform Decreto 196, P.O. 2 Dec. 2025)

los-cabos.nom: Los Cabos (Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo)
los-cabos.base: the highest of the contract price, the cadastral value and an expert commercial appraisal (under 90 days), less five times the daily UMA over a year

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda para el Municipio de Los Cabos, Baja California Sur, art. 35-39 (last reform BOGE 10 July 2025)

notes: The law deducts « five times the daily UMA, raised to a year » before the 3% rate: Payotte computes 5 × MX$117.31 × 365.

la-paz.base: the highest of the contract price, the cadastral value and an expert commercial appraisal (under 90 days); for a home, less five annual UMA

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda para el Municipio de La Paz, Baja California Sur, art. 38-42 (last reform BOGE 88, 24 Dec. 2025)

notes: The five-UMA deduction applies to land with a house; Payotte assumes a home.

loreto.base: the highest of the contract price, the cadastral value and an appraisal (under 120 days), less twice the daily UMA over a year

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda para el Municipio de Loreto, Baja California Sur, art. 14-18 (last reform BOGE 88, 24 Dec. 2025)

tijuana.base: the highest of the updated price, the cadastral value and a commercial appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Tijuana 2026, art. 8 (P.O. 78, 30 Dec. 2025)

notes: Tijuana's table is in UMA and is applied as published; its seventh bracket (3.318%) breaks the regular step of the others.

ensenada.base: the highest of the updated price, the cadastral value and a commercial appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Ensenada 2026, art. 4 (P.O. 30 Dec. 2025)

notes: Computed without the one-annual-UMA deduction of the state law, which Ensenada's law neither applies nor expressly excludes; with it, the tax would be about MX$1,500 to MX$2,200 lower.

rosarito.base: the highest of the updated price, the cadastral value and a commercial appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Playas de Rosarito 2026, art. 9 (P.O. 30 Dec. 2025)

notes: Computed without the one-annual-UMA deduction of the state law, which Rosarito's law does not mention.

mexicali.base: the highest of the updated price, the cadastral value and a commercial appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Mexicali 2026, art. 10 (compiled text of 15 May 2026)

guaymas.base: the highest of an appraisal (bank, public broker or registered appraiser, under 6 months), the cadastral value and the price

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Guaymas 2026, art. 17 (Ley 114, B.O. 26 Dec. 2025, electronic copy hosted by the municipality)

puerto-penasco.base: the highest of an appraisal (under 6 months), the cadastral value and the price

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Puerto Peñasco 2026, art. 16 (text approved by the Sonora Congress, Gaceta 2072, 13 Dec. 2025)

notes: The rate of the bracket applies to the whole base: a value of MX$2,500,000.01 or more is taxed at 3% on all of it.
Read in the text approved by the state Congress; the official gazette of Sonora could not be reached to compare the published version.

mazatlan.surtaxeLibelle: Additional tax for social assistance and sport
mazatlan.base: the higher of the transaction value and a bank, commercial, public-broker or cadastral appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda Municipal del Estado de Sinaloa, art. 45-51 and 105 (last reform P.O. 17 June 2024); Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Mazatlán 2026 (Decreto 321)

culiacan.surtaxeLibelle: Additional tax for social assistance and sport
culiacan.base: the higher of the transaction value and a bank, commercial, public-broker or cadastral appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda Municipal del Estado de Sinaloa, art. 45-51 and 105 (last reform P.O. 17 June 2024); Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Culiacán 2026 (Decreto 315)

chihuahua.fixesLibelle: Municipal contributions per transaction (IMPAS, women's institute, DIF, fire service)
chihuahua.base: the highest of an appraisal, the cadastral value and the value in the deed

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Chihuahua 2026, art. 55-56, 73-74 (Decreto LXVIII/APLIM/0409/2025, P.O. 103, 24 Dec. 2025)

ciudad-juarez.base: the highest of an appraisal, the cadastral value and the value in the deed

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Juárez 2026, art. 38 and 43 (Decreto LXVIII/APLIM/0427/2025, P.O. 103, 24 Dec. 2025)

saltillo.base: the higher of the declared value and the municipal cadastre's appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Saltillo 2026, art. 3 (Decreto 369, P.O. 102, 23 Dec. 2025)

notes: The cadastre also charges MX$935 for the tax appraisal and a valuation fee of 1.8 per thousand of the appraised value, not included here.

torreon.base: the higher of the declared value and the municipal cadastre's appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Torreón 2026, art. 3 (Decreto 374, P.O. 103, 26 Dec. 2025)

notes: The cadastre also charges MX$633 for the tax appraisal and 1.8 per thousand of the appraised value, not included here.

durango.base: the highest of the cadastral value, the market value and the transaction value

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Durango 2026, art. 20 (decree 308, P.O. 101 Bis, 18 Dec. 2025)

notes: On the first sale of a home, the land is exempt and only the building is taxed.

zacatecas.base: the highest of the declared value, the cadastral appraisal and a bank appraisal

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Zacatecas 2026, art. 52 (Decreto 308, P.O. 105 supplement 61, 31 Dec. 2025)

queretaro.base: the higher of the transaction value and an appraisal for tax purposes by an appraiser authorised by the state

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Querétaro 2026, art. 15 (La Sombra de Arteaga, 25 Dec. 2025)

notes: Querétaro's law excludes the social-housing deductions of the state law; the notary withholds the tax as the municipality's auxiliary.

leon.base: the highest of the fiscal value, the price and an appraisal by a certified appraiser, less ten annual UMA

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos para el Municipio de León 2026, art. 8 (P.O. 260, 30 Dec. 2025, with the correction of 30 Jan. 2026); Ley Hacendaria Municipal para el Estado de Guanajuato, art. 338

notes: Guanajuato's law first deducts ten annual UMA (MX$427,946.40) from the value of every purchase; more for social or popular housing that is the buyer's only property.

guanajuato.base: the highest of the fiscal value, the price and an appraisal by a certified appraiser, less ten annual UMA

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos para el Municipio de Guanajuato 2026, art. 7 (P.O. 260, 30 Dec. 2025); Ley Hacendaria Municipal para el Estado de Guanajuato, art. 338

notes: Guanajuato's law first deducts ten annual UMA (MX$427,946.40) from the value of every purchase.

san-miguel-de-allende.base: the highest of the fiscal value, the price and an appraisal by a certified appraiser, less ten annual UMA

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos para el Municipio de San Miguel de Allende 2026, art. 7 (P.O. 260, 30 Dec. 2025); Ley Hacendaria Municipal para el Estado de Guanajuato, art. 338

notes: San Miguel's law does not repeat the state deduction of ten annual UMA; Payotte applies it because the state law (art. 338) covers « all operations ». Without it, the tax would be MX$17,118 higher.

morelia.base: the higher of the acquisition value and the cadastral value, less three times the daily UMA over a year for a home above 25 times that amount

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda Municipal del Estado de Michoacán, art. 50-63 (last reform P.O. 22 Dec. 2022)

notes: Set by the state law for every municipality of Michoacán; Morelia's 2026 revenue law, which may add a minimum tax, could not be read.

aguascalientes.base: the appraisal for tax purposes, less five times the daily UMA over a year for a built property

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Aguascalientes 2026, art. 31 (Decreto 377, P.O. 26 Dec. 2025); Ley de Hacienda del Municipio de Aguascalientes, art. 64

notes: A home worth up to MX$423,852 bought by someone who owns no other property in the state pays 1.6% instead of 2.4% (not applied here).

san-luis-potosi.base: the highest of the agreed price, the commercial or declared value and the cadastral value

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de San Luis Potosí 2026, art. 10 (Decreto 0410, P.O. Plan de San Luis, 30 Dec. 2025)

notes: A first-time buyer of a new home declared at MX$1,800,000 or less may get a 50% incentive (not applied here).

cuernavaca.base: the highest of the acquisition value, the cadastral value and an authorised appraisal (under 6 months)

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Cuernavaca 2026, art. 7 (P.O. Tierra y Libertad 6509, 30 Dec. 2025), after art. 94 Ter of the state law

notes: The notary pays the tax first; the state law that sets the payment deadline could not be reached.

puebla.base: the highest of the acquisition value, the cadastral value and an appraisal by the cadastre or an authorised appraiser

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Puebla 2026, art. 6 (P.O. 15 Dec. 2025); Código Fiscal y Presupuestario para el Municipio de Puebla, art. 187-190

notes: Puebla's table gives a rate per bracket with no fixed amount: Payotte applies the bracket's rate to the whole value, as written; a marginal reading would give MX$45,000 instead of MX$54,000 on MX$3 million. Ask the municipal treasury.

pachuca.base: the highest of the cadastral, appraised, contract and commercial values, less five annual UMA

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos para el Municipio de Pachuca de Soto 2026, art. 8 (Decreto 499-LXVI, P.O. 31 Dec. 2025); Ley de Hacienda para los Municipios del Estado de Hidalgo, art. 29-32

tlaxcala.base: the highest of the transfer price, the cadastral, commercial, operation and fiscal values

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Tlaxcala 2026, art. 20 (Decreto 234, P.O. 24 Nov. 2025); Código Financiero para el Estado de Tlaxcala y sus Municipios, art. 208-211
Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Durango, art. 120-I (Decreto 304, P.O. 100, 14 Dec. 2025)
Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Guanajuato 2026, art. 10-II-a (P.O. 260, 30 Dec. 2025)

notes: Guanajuato: MX$2,574 at the registry office, MX$2,460 online.

source.titre: Ley Estatal de Derechos de Hidalgo, art. 8-VI (last reform P.O. 31 Dec. 2025)
Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Jalisco 2026, art. 16 (decree 30121/LXIV/25, published 23 Dec. 2025)

notes: Jalisco charges MX$4,801 to record a home that is not economic, social or popular housing (lower fixed fees below a cadastral value of MX$1,238,206); non-residential property pays 0.5% of the value.

source.titre: IRYCEM, Registro Público de la Propiedad costs 2026, from Decreto Legislativo 385 (P.O. 9 Dec. 2025), art. 23-I-C

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Nayarit 2026, art. 18 (P.O. 29 Dec. 2025)
Ley Estatal de Derechos de Oaxaca, art. 44-I (consolidated 21 Dec. 2024; later decrees read do not amend it)
Ley de Derechos del Estado de Quintana Roo, art. 29-I (last reform 18 Dec. 2025)

notes: Recording fee: 65 UMA per act and folio, plus 0.2 UMA per page of the deed (pages not included).

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Sinaloa, art. 50-II (last reform P.O. 085, 17 July 2026)

notes: Sinaloa: 0.75% of the value, capped at 750 daily UMA; a home with a cadastral value up to 7,500 daily UMA pays it on half of the value (not applied here).

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Tabasco, art. 73-A-I-b (last reform P.O. 11 Apr. 2026)

notes: Tabasco also allows an optional 1% of the value instead of 180 UMA; the fixed fee is lower above about MX$2.1 million.

source.titre: Ley de Hacienda para el Estado de Tamaulipas, art. 64-I (last reform P.O. 18 Aug. 2026)
Código Financiero para el Estado de Tlaxcala y sus Municipios, art. 147-I (last reform 28 Nov. 2025)

notes: Tlaxcala: 15 UMA up to 100 annual UMA of value (MX$4,279,464), 25 UMA above, on the cadastre's valuation.

source.titre: Código de Derechos para el Estado de Veracruz, art. 13-A-I (last reform Decreto 245, G.O. 9 May 2025)
Ley General de Hacienda del Estado de Yucatán, art. 59-I and II (last reform D.O. 26 Dec. 2025)
Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Zacatecas, art. 102 (amounts reformed 31 Dec. 2025; last reform 22 Aug. 2026)

notes: Zacatecas: a 10% tax for the state university on state taxes and fees may also apply; not confirmed, not included.

source.titre: Ley de Derechos del Estado de Chiapas, art. 47 Ter-I-a (last reform P.O. 123, 19 Aug. 2026)
Ley de Hacienda para el Estado de Colima, art. 62 Bis 1-I and I Bis (last reform P.O. 30 June 2026)

notes: Colima: 9, 12 or 16 UMA up to 6,116 UMA of value, then 0.3% (at least 17 and at most 2,162 UMA), plus 2 UMA to examine the deed.

source.titre: Ley de Derechos y Productos del Estado de Baja California Sur, art. 27-III (last reform BOGE 39, 14 May 2026)

notes: Baja California Sur: MX$375 to examine the deed, MX$469 fixed and 3.25 per thousand of the value.

source.titre: Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Baja California 2026, art. 12-I and III (last reform P.O. 35, 18 June 2026)
Ley Estatal de Derechos de Chihuahua, art. 29-I-a (last reform P.O. 103, 24 Dec. 2025)
Ley de Hacienda para el Estado de Coahuila de Zaragoza, art. 54-II (reformed P.O. 30 Dec. 2025)

notes: Coahuila: the law also mentions a 10% additional tax on registry fees and a 22.5% tax for education and public security; Payotte could not confirm how they apply, and they are not included.

10.answer: In Durango, the acquisition tax on a MX$3 million home is MX$111,679 in Durango, under its 2026 law (the only municipality of the state Payotte computes).

sources.title: Ley de Ingresos del Municipio de Durango 2026, art. 20 (decree 308, P.O. 101 Bis, 18 Dec. 2025)

11.answer: In Guanajuato, the acquisition tax on a MX$3 million home ranges from MX$24,144 in Guanajuato to MX$82,007 in San Miguel de Allende, among the 3 municipalities whose 2026 law Payotte read.

sources.title: Ley de Ingresos para el Municipio de Guanajuato 2026, art. 7 (P.O. 260, 30 Dec. 2025); Ley Hacendaria Municipal para el Estado de Guanajuato, art. 338
Ley de Ingresos para el Municipio de León 2026, art. 8 (P.O. 260, 30 Dec. 2025, with the correction of 30 Jan. 2026); Ley Hacendaria Municipal para el Estado de Guanajuato, art. 338
Ley de Ingresos para el Municipio de San Miguel de Allende 2026, art. 7 (P.O. 260, 30 Dec. 2025); Ley Hacendaria Municipal para el Estado de Guanajuato, art. 338

13.answer: In Hidalgo, the acquisition tax on a MX$3 million home is MX$55,721 in Pachuca, under its 2026 law (the only municipality of the state Payotte computes).

10.answer: In Durango, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$23,462 on MX$3 million, whatever the price.

sources.title: Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Durango, art. 120-I (Decreto 304, P.O. 100, 14 Dec. 2025)

11.answer: In Guanajuato, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$2,574 on MX$3 million, whatever the price.
11.note: Guanajuato: MX$2,574 at the registry office, MX$2,460 online.

sources.title: Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Guanajuato 2026, art. 10-II-a (P.O. 260, 30 Dec. 2025)

13.answer: In Hidalgo, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$11,438 on MX$3 million, whatever the price.

sources.title: Ley Estatal de Derechos de Hidalgo, art. 8-VI (last reform P.O. 31 Dec. 2025)

14.answer: In Jalisco, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$4,801 on MX$3 million, whatever the price.
14.note: Jalisco charges MX$4,801 to record a home that is not economic, social or popular housing (lower fixed fees below a cadastral value of MX$1,238,206); non-residential property pays 0.5% of the value.

sources.title: Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Jalisco 2026, art. 16 (decree 30121/LXIV/25, published 23 Dec. 2025)

16.answer: In Michoacán, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$1,349 on MX$3 million, whatever the price.
16.note: Michoacán: 11.5 UMA (MX$1,349 as published by the registry) for a home worth more than 25 annual UMA.

sources.title: IRYCEM, Registro Público de la Propiedad costs 2026, from Decreto Legislativo 385 (P.O. 9 Dec. 2025), art. 23-I-C

18.answer: In Nayarit, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$15,461 on MX$3 million, whatever the price.

sources.title: Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Nayarit 2026, art. 18 (P.O. 29 Dec. 2025)

20.answer: In Oaxaca, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$1,642 on MX$3 million, whatever the price.

sources.title: Ley Estatal de Derechos de Oaxaca, art. 44-I (consolidated 21 Dec. 2024; later decrees read do not amend it)

23.answer: In Quintana Roo, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$7,625 on MX$3 million, whatever the price.
23.note: Recording fee: 65 UMA per act and folio, plus 0.2 UMA per page of the deed (pages not included).

sources.title: Ley de Derechos del Estado de Quintana Roo, art. 29-I (last reform 18 Dec. 2025)

25.answer: In Sinaloa, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$22,500 on MX$3 million and MX$60,000 on MX$8 million.
25.note: Sinaloa: 0.75% of the value, capped at 750 daily UMA; a home with a cadastral value up to 7,500 daily UMA pays it on half of the value (not applied here).

sources.title: Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Sinaloa, art. 50-II (last reform P.O. 085, 17 July 2026)

27.answer: In Tabasco, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$21,116 on MX$3 million, whatever the price.
27.note: Tabasco also allows an optional 1% of the value instead of 180 UMA; the fixed fee is lower above about MX$2.1 million.

sources.title: Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Tabasco, art. 73-A-I-b (last reform P.O. 11 Apr. 2026)

28.answer: In Tamaulipas, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$24,000 on MX$3 million and MX$58,655 on MX$8 million.

29.answer: In Tlaxcala, the fee to record the deed of a home sale at the Registro Público de la Propiedad is MX$1,760 on MX$3 million and MX$2,933 on MX$8 million.
